methodology.paired_lookup_win_requirement: At least 75% of randomized calibration rounds
methodology.calibration: Nine randomized rounds, target 8 ms per candidate sample, four seeded random inputs; correctness checked before selection.
methodology.heldout: 13 independent randomized rounds, target 20 ms per candidate sample, eight new random seeds, fresh input pool; same reused plan.
methodology.timed_c_work: Binary-value validation, input gathers, arithmetic or key packing and full table copies, upper merges. Selected path dispatches once through a C function pointer.
methodology.public_api: Includes dtype/shape/contiguity checks, C binary validation, ctypes overhead, and output allocation where labeled. No input conversion/copy.
methodology.overhead: Ordinary shared plan setup, adaptive plan setup (including tiny tables), and calibration reported separately. Compilation/import excluded.
methodology.break_even: Only positive held-out measured savings yield break-even; otherwise null. Benchmarks are noisy VM observations, not guaranteed crossovers.
methodology.cache: Bounded process-local LRU keyed by N and uint8/bool dtype, capacity eight. Retuning explicit only.
methodology.dispatch_timing_caution: selected_dispatch_excess_us is the difference of two noisy end-to-end medians, NOT an isolated dispatch-overhead measurement.
methodology.final_source_note: After timing, validation guards were tightened for integer cache keys and aligned outputs, and the explicit method= no-calibration API was added. The C kernels and selector rules were unchanged; targeted final-source guard tests passed.
